tool.name: Count Label Overlaps
tool.description: Count or average number of overlapping labels.
tool.command: python3 $__tool_directory__/custom_average_label_overlaps.py \ --input_csv '${input_csv}' \ --output_csv '${output_csv}' \ #if str($label1_min) != '' and str($label1_min) != 'None': --label1_min '${label1_min}' #end if #if str($label1_max) != '' and str($label1_max) != 'None': --label1_max '${label1_max}' #end if #if $average: --average #end if

param.name: average
param.label: Compute average number of label2 per label1 instead of counts per label1

data.name: output_csv
data.label: Counts or averages of overlapping labels

tool.help:
This tool counts or averages the number of overlapping label2 per label1 based on the CSV output of the *Label Overlaps* tool.
**Inputs:** - CSV file containing at least `image1`, `label1`, and `label2` columns. - Optional minimum and maximum for `label1`. - Optional boolean to compute average instead of per-label counts.
**Output:** - A CSV with either: - Columns: `image1`, `label1`, `label2_count` (counts per label1) - or Columns: `image1`, `average_number_of_label2_per_label1` (averages per image)
